The Universe

Built around connected worlds.

Nova Universe is an original cinematic universe where mythology, cosmic forces, heroes and multiple dimensions exist within one expanding continuity.

✦

Original Mythology

Ancient legends and original cosmic mythology combine to create a unique universe.

∞

Multiverse

Different worlds and dimensions can connect, collide and influence one another.

◈

Shared Continuity

Characters and events can cross between different parts of the universe while remaining connected.

Character Archive

Meet the universe.

The complete character archive, arranged alphabetically across the established Nova Universe stories and current canon. Add official artwork to any profile.

Anubis WarriorCharacter artwork

Anubis Warrior

Omar Hasan • Divine Mark Bearer

A warrior chosen by the legacy of Anubis. His abilities connect him to the dead, allowing him to perceive spirits, bind souls and move through the veil between life and death. He becomes one of the five God-chosen warriors gathered for the coming Dimension Wars.

Spirit Sight • Soul Manipulation • Veil Step
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
AnwenCharacter artwork

Anwen

Former Gladeguard • Talan’s Mentor

Anwen trained Talan Reyes for eight years and taught him that the living world should be understood rather than simply forced. She died protecting her grove, but her teachings continue to shape Talan’s choices and his responsibility as a Gladeguard.

Gladeguard Training • Nature Knowledge
Team / Role: Gladeguard Legacy
Arjun RaoCharacter artwork

Arjun Rao

Suryavanshi • Son of the Sun

Arjun begins as an ordinary young man before an ancient power awakens within him. His connection to Karna’s Kavacha and Kundala gives him solar abilities, divine armor and extraordinary archery. He later discovers that his awakening is part of a much older God War.

Solar Energy • Divine Armor • Vijaya Bow
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
AshwatthamaCharacter artwork

Ashwatthama

Chiranjeevi • Ancient Warrior

The immortal warrior of the Mahabharata era carries an ancient curse and the weight of centuries of history. In Dimension Wars he becomes a guide for Arjun, revealing the forgotten God War, the chosen warriors and the threat posed by Azeroth.

Ancient Warrior • Immortality • Divine Knowledge
Team / Role: Chiranjeevi / Guide
AzerothCharacter artwork

Azeroth

Immortal • Master of the Ten Rings

Azeroth is an ancient immortal and former ally of the Void King. Unable to accept the loss of ten mortal warriors who served him, he transformed them into rings, preserving their existence and granting them supernatural powers. He later sends his first five Apostles to search for Velkris.

Immortality • Ring Creation • Ancient Power
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Ten Rings
BloomCharacter artwork

Bloom

Primordial • Life

Bloom embodies Life and growth. She chose Earth and humanity, planted Anantavriksha and left behind a legacy that would eventually connect the planet to the wider multiverse. Her influence remains part of the foundation of the Gladeguard story.

Life • Growth • Creation
Team / Role: The Primordials
CorvainCharacter artwork

Corvain

Sentinel • Boundaries

Corvain represents the boundaries that separate one thing from another. His purpose is tied to containment, limits and the definition of reality. He was among the Sentinels who remained loyal before being captured and forced into service.

Boundary Control • Containment
Team / Role: The Sentinels
Darian VossCharacter artwork

Darian Voss

Moonfang • Werewolf Hero

Darian carries a generational werewolf curse rather than an infection. After being feared by his own village, he chooses to master the beast instead of running from it, eventually using Moonfang’s strength to protect others and joining the wider heroic conflict.

Werewolf Physiology • Enhanced Strength • Regeneration
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse
Draevor MalrecCharacter artwork

Draevor Malrec

Lord Noctis • Vampire

Draevor is a powerful vampire whose existence began through one of the supernatural bargains connected to the Bargainer. He becomes Darian’s enemy before joining Draven’s campaign against the Divine Trees, turning a local supernatural threat into a multiversal one.

Vampiric Powers • Superhuman Speed • Regeneration
Team / Role: Draven’s Alliance
DraustCharacter artwork

Draust

Sentinel • Void

Draust represents the Void and absence. His conceptual power is tied to removing space and creating emptiness where something once existed. He belongs to the original Sentinel mythology rather than the independent Void King’s later history.

Void • Spatial Absence
Team / Role: The Sentinels
DravenCharacter artwork

Draven

Multiversal Antagonist • Joren’s Son

Joren’s son, Draven becomes obsessed with ancient knowledge and turns against the Divine Trees. He seeks to destroy them and destabilize the multiverse, eventually using Murk’s cursed energy to control a temporary army of Void soldiers.

Shadow Power • Ancient Knowledge • Void Army Control
Team / Role: Draven’s Alliance
DrekarCharacter artwork

Drekar

Azeroth’s Apostle • Soul Manipulator

Drekar is one of Azeroth’s first five Apostles. His ring preserves the existence of a former mortal warrior while giving him the ability to manipulate souls, making him a dangerous opponent for the Divine Five.

Soul Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Five Apostles
ErebosCharacter artwork

Erebos

Primordial • Darkness / Entropy

Erebos embodies darkness, entropy and necessary endings. He is not simply an embodiment of evil; his role provides a cosmic counterbalance to Noor’s light and represents the darker forces that are part of creation itself.

Darkness • Entropy
Team / Role: The Primordials
Eric HalversonCharacter artwork

Eric Halverson

Odin’s Chosen • Divine Spear Warrior

Eric is the mortal chosen to carry Odin’s legacy into the new age. His powers are expressed through runes, divine combat and the spear Runebreaker. He becomes one of the five God-chosen warriors needed for the coming war.

Rune Enhancement • Odin’s Sight • Runebreaker
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
EryxCharacter artwork

Eryx

Azeroth’s Ring Warrior • Illusionist

Eryx is one of Azeroth’s ten transformed warriors. Her ring grants the ability to manipulate perception and minds through illusions, making her dangerous because enemies cannot always trust what they see or remember.

Illusion • Mind Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Ten Rings
HalvornCharacter artwork

Halvorn

Sentinel • Structure

Halvorn represents Structure and the foundations that allow reality to exist. His original purpose was constructive, but he was eventually captured and forced into service during the ancient Sentinel conflict.

Structure • Reality Foundations
Team / Role: The Sentinels
JorenCharacter artwork

Joren

Gladeguard from Another Universe • Draven’s Father

Joren is an experienced Gladeguard who travels between worlds after the destruction of his own universe. He warns Talan about the threat to Divine Trees and carries the painful knowledge that his own son became one of the greatest threats to them.

Gladeguard Arts • Interworld Travel
Team / Role: Gladeguard Legacy
KaelzharCharacter artwork

Kaelzhar

Void King • Independent Cosmic Threat

Kaelzhar is the finalized name reserved for the independent Void King. He is not a Sentinel creation and has his own origin, kingdom and history. His deeper story belongs to Dimension Wars, where the Void Dimension and its ancient history become central to the conflict.

Void Power • Ancient Divine Power
Team / Role: Independent / Void Kingdom
Kai LiangCharacter artwork

Kai Liang

Astrael’s Potential Heir • Future Hero

Kai is Master Liang Wei’s grandson. After his parents die in a disaster and Kai disappears, Astrael rejects replacement successors, suggesting that its true bloodline heir may still be alive. His future connection to Guardian Force remains one of the universe’s developing storylines.

Guardian Force • Astrael
Team / Role: Astrael Legacy
KarnaCharacter artwork

Karna

Ancient Warrior • Kavacha and Kundala Legacy

The legendary warrior whose courage becomes an important part of Suryavanshi’s origin. His Kavacha and Kundala are hidden by Indra, and their later connection to Arjun becomes the source of an ancient responsibility that reaches far beyond the Mahabharata era.

Kavacha • Kundala • Legendary Archery
Team / Role: Ancient Divine Legacy
KharzaCharacter artwork

Kharza

Azeroth’s Ring Warrior • Beast Shifter

Kharza is one of the ten mortal warriors transformed by Azeroth into a ring-bound immortal being. His supernatural ability allows him to transform into powerful beasts, giving Azeroth a versatile close-combat hunter.

Beast Transformation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Ten Rings
KhazealCharacter artwork

Khazeal

Ancient God-War Threat • Void-Sealed Being

Khazeal is connected to an ancient war between gods and is sealed within the Void Dimension. His ability to return to Earth is tied to the mysterious sword revealed in the Phase One museum post-credit, while the full history is reserved for Dimension Wars.

Ancient Power • Void Connection
Team / Role: Void Dimension / Ancient God War
Leo CruzCharacter artwork

Leo Cruz

Quetzalcoatl Warrior • Wind Bearer

Leo is the chosen warrior who carries the legacy of Quetzalcoatl. His command of wind allows him to create blasts, barriers and massive attacks, while his deeper connection to an ancient sealed world gives his story a larger cosmic purpose.

Wind Manipulation • Sky Glide • Serpent Power
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
Lin YueCharacter artwork

Lin Yue

Lumera • Shield of Two Worlds

Lin Yue is a sixteen-year-old survivor from another universe whose mother sends her through a dimensional gateway when their world collapses. In China she learns martial arts from Master Liang Wei and awakens Shield Magic and Aroma Magic, eventually becoming Lumera.

Shield Magic • Aroma Magic • Overload
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse
Lin Yue’s MotherCharacter artwork

Lin Yue’s Mother

Glade Guardian of Lin Yue’s Original Universe

Lin Yue’s mother is the Glade Guardian of the universe Lin Yue came from. When her world begins to collapse, she sacrifices the chance to remain with her daughter and sends Lin Yue through a gateway with one final mission: find the Glade Guardian of the new universe.

Gladeguard Arts • Dimensional Travel
Team / Role: Gladeguard Legacy
Master Liang WeiCharacter artwork

Master Liang Wei

Kung Fu Master • Temple Guardian

An elderly martial arts master who shelters Lin Yue and teaches her discipline, combat and control. His family has protected a temple for generations because it hides Astrael, an ancient Guardian Spear tied to their bloodline.

Martial Arts • Temple Knowledge
Team / Role: Astrael Legacy
MorvaneCharacter artwork

Morvane

Azeroth’s Ring Warrior • Life-Force Manipulator

Morvane is one of Azeroth’s ten transformed warriors. Her ring grants control over life force, making her capable of draining, manipulating or redirecting the energy that sustains living beings.

Life-Force Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Ten Rings
MurkCharacter artwork

Murk

Sentinel • Influence

Murk represents Influence and the ability to affect decisions, instincts and behavior. He became associated with manipulation and is responsible for creating the Bargainer. His cursed energy later becomes the mechanism Draven uses to control Void soldiers.

Influence • Manipulation • Cursed Energy
Team / Role: The Sentinels / Rogue Sentinel
NoorCharacter artwork

Noor

Primordial • Light

Noor represents Light and order. She is one of the Primordials who helped shape the post-Sentinel age and believed creation could become better after the ancient wars. Her light stands in cosmic balance with Erebos.

Light • Cosmic Order
Team / Role: The Primordials
NovaCharacter artwork

Nova

Guardian of the Multiverse • Timeline Watcher

Nova was created after the original universe was shattered into the multiverse. She can observe and protect timelines but cannot change what she sees. Her role is to watch over reality while other heroes are allowed to act.

Timeline Awareness • Cosmic Protection
Team / Role: Cosmic Guardians
NyxaraCharacter artwork

Nyxara

Azeroth’s Apostle • Shadow Manipulator

Nyxara is one of Azeroth’s first five Apostles. Her ring preserves an ancient warrior while granting powerful shadow manipulation, making her a stealth-oriented threat during the search for Velkris and the chosen warriors.

Shadow Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Five Apostles
Omar HasanCharacter artwork

Omar Hasan

Anubis Warrior • Divine Mark Bearer

Omar Hasan is the mortal identity of the Anubis warrior. His Divine Mark connects him to the legacy of Anubis and grants him abilities involving spirits, souls and the veil of death. He is one of the four warriors Arjun must find.

Spirit Sight • Soul Binding • Veil Step
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
Quetzalcoatl WarriorCharacter artwork

Quetzalcoatl Warrior

Leo Cruz • Serpent Legacy

The chosen champion of Quetzalcoatl, represented in the modern world by Leo Cruz. His divine legacy is expressed through wind and serpent-based power, including an ancient sealed realm whose secrets are connected to the larger Dimension Wars.

Wind Energy • Ancient Serpent Power
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
Ren-KaelCharacter artwork

Ren-Kael

Sentinel • Reflection / Pattern

Ren-Kael represents reflection and patterns. His ability to reproduce or mirror existing powers reflects the nature of his original purpose, while his inability to truly originate things contributes to his identity conflict.

Reflection • Pattern Replication
Team / Role: The Sentinels
Sara MarisCharacter artwork

Sara Maris

Queen Seraphina of Calypserra • Ocean Warrior

Sara Maris is the human identity of Queen Seraphina of Calypserra. Her divine legacy gives her command over water, underwater transformation and the Trident of Calypserra. She becomes one of the five God-chosen warriors.

Hydrokinesis • Mermaid Form • Trident Combat
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
Scorpio AssassinCharacter artwork

Scorpio Assassin

Zodiac Operative • Hunter of Lumera

An assassin sent by the Scorpio Division after its earlier operations against Lin Yue fail. The assassin’s personal identity and full abilities remain unrevealed, leaving the character as an open threat within the Zodiac storyline.

Assassination • Unknown Abilities
Team / Role: The Zodiac / Scorpio Division
Scorpio Division LeaderCharacter artwork

Scorpio Division Leader

Zodiac Commander • China Division

The unnamed commander of the Zodiac’s Scorpio Division. After his younger brother’s defeat during the temple conflict, he orders an assassin to pursue Lin Yue, establishing Scorpio as an ongoing threat rather than a one-time enemy.

Leadership • Unknown Abilities
Team / Role: The Zodiac / Scorpio Division
Scorpio Superhuman FighterCharacter artwork

Scorpio Superhuman Fighter

Scorpio Combatant • Leader’s Younger Brother

A powerful muscular fighter serving the Scorpio Division. He initially overwhelms Lin Yue physically, forcing her developing powers to awaken. He survives the encounter badly injured, leaving his future role open.

Superhuman Strength • Enhanced Durability
Team / Role: The Zodiac / Scorpio Division
SelkeCharacter artwork

Selke

Sentinel • Entropy

Selke represents Entropy and endings. One of the six Sentinels who rebelled against the Unmade, Selke belongs to the ancient cosmic conflict that ultimately contributed to the creation of the multiverse.

Entropy • Decay
Team / Role: The Sentinels
SeraphinaCharacter artwork

Seraphina

Queen of Calypserra • Divine Ocean Warrior

Seraphina is the divine title of Sara Maris, Queen of Calypserra. She can manipulate water, fight with the Trident of Calypserra and call upon powerful oceanic forces. Her abilities become part of the Divine Five during Dimension Wars.

Water Control • Ocean Power • Trident
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
SkarnCharacter artwork

Skarn

Sentinel • Chaos

Skarn represents Chaos, randomness and unpredictability. He is one of the three major rogue Sentinels who refused the peace after the multiverse was formed. His history remains tied to the larger cosmic threat surrounding the Sentinel wars.

Chaos • Reality Disruption
Team / Role: The Sentinels / Rogue Sentinel
Star GuardianCharacter artwork

Star Guardian

Cosmic Hunter • Cosmic Warrior

Created by Sthenos after the rogue Sentinels escaped, Star Guardian is allowed to act where Nova cannot. He arrives during the Phase One finale to protect civilians and help the heroes fight the Void army, becoming a future member of the Masters.

Cosmic Energy • Flight • Hunter Abilities
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse
SthenosCharacter artwork

Sthenos

Primordial • Force

Sthenos embodies Force and decisive action. After the rogue Sentinels escaped, he created Star Guardian as a hunter who could act where Nova could only watch. His influence connects the ancient cosmic wars to the heroes of the present.

Force • Cosmic Creation
Team / Role: The Primordials
Stone GuardianCharacter artwork

Stone Guardian

Golem • Ancient Guardian

The Stone Guardian began as a protector created by Talan from stone connected to Anantavriksha. In the Phase One finale, Lumera summons the Golem by calling his name and pressing her palm to the ground, bringing an ancient guardian back into the battle.

Stone Body • Superhuman Strength • Guardian Defense
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse
SuryavanshiCharacter artwork

Suryavanshi

Arjun Rao • Divine Archer

Suryavanshi is the hero identity of Arjun Rao. His power is not a simple bloodline; it is connected to Karna’s Kavacha and Kundala. He wields the Vijaya Bow and channels solar energy, becoming one of the five warriors tied to the ancient God War.

Solar Arrows • Solar Sight • Solar Armor • Vijaya Bow
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse / Divine Five
Talan ReyesCharacter artwork

Talan Reyes

Glade Guardian • Masters Leader

Talan is the current Gladeguard chosen by Anantavriksha. Trained by Anwen, he protects the Divine Tree and becomes the central organizer of the heroes who eventually form the Masters of the Multiverse.

Wild Magic • Nature Magic • Glade Wand
Team / Role: Masters of the Multiverse
TharokCharacter artwork

Tharok

Azeroth’s Ring Warrior • Matter Manipulator

Tharok is one of Azeroth’s ten transformed warriors. His ring grants control over matter, making him capable of changing or manipulating physical substances and turning the environment itself into a weapon.

Matter Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Ten Rings
The BargainerCharacter artwork

The Bargainer

Murk’s Creation • Cosmic Deal-Maker

The Bargainer is a mysterious entity created by Murk. He travels between universes, offers supernatural bargains and deliberately creates conflicts. He is behind the separate bargains that produced the first vampire and werewolf lines, but his deeper purpose remains hidden.

Bargains • Manipulation • Interuniversal Travel
Team / Role: Independent Cosmic Actor
The UnmadeCharacter artwork

The Unmade

Original Existence • Creator of the Sentinels

The Unmade is the first known existence in Nova Universe cosmology. It created the nine Sentinels and gave them the purpose of building a perfect universe. Their rebellion became the foundation of the ancient cosmic wars that eventually shattered reality into the multiverse.

Primordial Creation • Cosmic Authority
Team / Role: Ancient Cosmic Order
VahlCharacter artwork

Vahl

Primordial • Time

Vahl represents Time and possesses extraordinary temporal perception. His nature allows him to understand events across time and anticipate actions, making the Time Primordial an important part of the deeper cosmic structure.

Time • Temporal Perception
Team / Role: The Primordials
VarkonCharacter artwork

Varkon

Azeroth’s Apostle • Gravity Manipulator

Varkon is one of Azeroth’s first five Apostles. His ring grants gravity manipulation, allowing him to increase, reduce or redirect gravitational force and turn movement itself into a weapon.

Gravity Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Five Apostles
VolkrisCharacter artwork

Volkris

Azeroth’s Ring Warrior • Fire and Magma

Volkris is one of Azeroth’s five hidden ring warriors. His powers are centered on fire and magma, giving Azeroth a devastating elemental weapon for later escalation.

Fire • Magma Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Ten Rings
YtheCharacter artwork

Ythe

Sentinel • Cohesion

Ythe represents Cohesion and the forces that keep things together. She sensed the separation caused by the Sentinel betrayal and was among the loyal Sentinels who were captured and forced into service.

Cohesion • Structural Binding
Team / Role: The Sentinels
ZaelCharacter artwork

Zael

Sentinel • Consumption

Zael represents Consumption. His original purpose became corrupted into endless hunger, making him one of the most dangerous rogue Sentinels and one of the three who rejected the peace after the multiverse was formed.

Consumption • Absorption
Team / Role: The Sentinels / Rogue Sentinel
ZyphorCharacter artwork

Zyphor

Azeroth’s Apostle • Time Manipulator

Zyphor is one of Azeroth’s first five Apostles. His ring grants control over time, making him one of the most dangerous members of the first group sent to Earth in search of Velkris and the chosen warriors.

Time Manipulation
Team / Role: Azeroth’s Five Apostles
Teams & Factions

The forces of Nova Universe.

Major teams, organizations and cosmic factions that connect the stories. Character profiles remain in the alphabetical archive above.

Masters of the Multiverse

Heroic Alliance

Heroes united around Talan Reyes and the protection of the Divine Trees and the multiverse. The Phase One finale establishes the team as the central heroic group, with Talan, Suryavanshi, Lumera, Darian, Stone Guardian and Star Guardian connected to its formation.

Members: Talan Reyes • Suryavanshi • Lumera • Darian Voss • Stone Guardian • Star Guardian

The Zodiac

Global Antagonist Organization

A single worldwide organization divided into twelve zodiac-sign divisions. Its goal is domination of Earth. Scorpio is the China division and is the first branch directly encountered by Lumera.

Members: Aries • Taurus • Gemini • Cancer • Leo • Virgo • Libra • Scorpio • Sagittarius • Capricorn • Aquarius • Pisces

The Sentinels

Ancient Cosmic Order

Nine cosmic beings created by the Unmade, each embodying a fundamental concept. Their rebellion and later conflicts form one of the deepest foundations of Nova Universe cosmology.

Members: Halvorn • Ythe • Corvain • Selke • Draust • Ren-Kael • Zael • Murk • Skarn

The Primordials

Cosmic Creation / Balance

Five cosmic beings created to oppose the Sentinel rebellion. Their concepts include Time, Light, Darkness/Entropy, Force and Life, and their actions helped shape the multiverse after the ancient wars.

Members: Vahl • Noor • Erebos • Sthenos • Bloom

Azeroth’s Ten Rings

Major Antagonist Faction

Ten former mortal warriors transformed by Azeroth into rings. Each ring preserves its warrior and grants supernatural power. Five Apostles are sent first to search for Velkris and the God-chosen warriors.

Members: Varkon • Nyxara • Drekar • Seraphex • Zyphor • Volkris • Morvane • Kharza • Eryx • Tharok

The Divine Five

God-Chosen Warriors

The five God-chosen warriors at the center of Dimension Wars: Suryavanshi, the Anubis warrior, Seraphina, the Quetzalcoatl warrior and Odin’s Chosen. They are gathered to face the ancient threats surrounding Velkris and the God War.

Members: Suryavanshi • Omar Hasan • Sara Maris • Leo Cruz • Eric Halverson

Draven’s Alliance

Multiversal Threat

The hostile force surrounding Draven’s campaign against the Divine Trees. Lord Noctis joins Draven, while Murk’s cursed energy allows Draven to temporarily control Void soldiers.

Members: Draven • Lord Noctis • Void Soldiers • Murk’s cursed stone

Chiranjeevis

Ancient Guardians

Ancient immortal warriors connected to Indian mythology who survived into the modern era. Ashwatthama serves as a key guide in Dimension Wars and reveals the history of the ancient God War.

Members: Ashwatthama • Other Chiranjeevis remain part of the wider lore
